resources.string: The volume keys turn the steps: down for the next step, up for the previous one. Also under the Handsfree button in cook mode.
Say “next”, “back” or “repeat” while cook mode is shown. The phone recognises your voice by itself: no sound leaves your kitchen.
The phone reads a step when you turn to it.
Say “next”, “back” or “repeat” while cook mode is shown. With the phone’s speech service, your speech may be sent over the internet to that service.

Listens in the app’s language with the phone’s regular speech service (for example Google’s), without the internet when the phone has the language downloaded. Otherwise your speech may be sent over the internet to that service. Off: only the phone’s own recognition, nothing leaves the phone.
